title.zh-Hans: 落地页与网页效果（第 2 弹）

meaning.en: A timeline line grows as you scroll
meaning.zh-Hans: 滚动时时间轴的线条随之延伸

ask.en: Turn the company history into a timeline on scroll: grow the vertical line with the scroll and reveal each year as the line reaches it.
ask.zh-Hans: 把公司沿革做成滚动时间轴：竖线随滚动延伸，线到达哪一年就依次显示该年内容。

summary.en: As the page scrolls down, an orange line grows down the timeline; each dot it reaches fills in and its year and event slide in from the right. Scrolling back up reverses it.

en: A 511 × 168 browser viewport. Scroll: 0→190 px over 0.3–2.3 s, 190→0 over 3.0–4.3 s (cubic ease-in-out). One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).
The timeline line is at x = 168: an orange line grows over a gray track (width 3). Its tip sits at scroll + 126 px, so always 126 px from the top of the viewport (42 px from the bottom).
Five items (2018–2026), with dots (white, radius 7.5, ring width 2.5) at page y = 72, 126, 180, 234 and 288.

Over the 22 px of line growth after the tip passes a dot (cubic ease-out): the ring turns orange, an inner dot grows from radius 0 to 4, and the year (18 px, orange) and event (15 px) fade in while sliding 16 px from the right.
Scrolling back shrinks the line and hides the items by the same formula. The scrollbar thumb on the right follows the scroll.

use.en: Use it for company history, milestones or a step-by-step process that reads in time order.

meaning.en: Text darkens letter by letter as you scroll
meaning.zh-Hans: 随着阅读，文字逐字变深

ask.en: Add a scroll text reveal to the concept statement: start in light gray and darken it one character at a time as the page scrolls.
ask.zh-Hans: 给理念文案加上滚动文字显现：初始为浅灰色，随滚动逐字加深。

summary.en: A light gray headline darkens one character at a time from the top left as the page scrolls, and fades back from the end when scrolling up.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport. Scroll progress p: 0→1 over 0.3–2.6 s, 1→0 over 3.2–4.4 s (cubic ease-in-out). The page moves up by p × 40 px. One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).
A three-line headline, 24 characters in all (27 px, weight 800, 38 px line height), all light gray (#D6DBE4) at the start.
Character n (counting from 0) has darkness clamp(p × 26 − n): each character takes 1/26 of the progress to reach the text color (#1C2333), in step with the scroll.
Scrolling back fades them from the last character by the same formula. The body-text bars and the scrollbar thumb move with the page.

use.en: Use it on a short statement, such as a concept or a message from the founder, that should be read slowly.

meaning.en: Cards stack on top of each other on scroll
meaning.zh-Hans: 滚动时卡片层层叠起

ask.en: Show the three service steps as stacking cards: on scroll, each card slides up and stacks 12 px below the top of the one before.
ask.zh-Hans: 把服务的三个步骤做成堆叠卡片：滚动时下一张从下方升起，每张比前一张错开 12 px 叠上去。

summary.en: On scroll, the next card rises from below and stacks over the previous one with a small offset; the cards underneath shrink a little and darken.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport. Scroll step s: 0→1 over 0.3–1.1 s, 1→2 over 1.6–2.4 s, 2→0 over 3.2–4.4 s (cubic ease-in-out). One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).
Three cards (371 × 124, radius 12, centered), 170 px apart on the page; each step of s moves them up 170 px.
They stop 14, 26 and 38 px from the top (position: sticky with the top offset 12 px larger for each card), so each new card covers the one before.
For each card stacked on top, the card underneath shrinks 4.5% (9% for two) around the middle of its top edge and darkens under a navy layer (up to 16%).
Card shadow: 14 px blur, 2 px upward. The scrollbar thumb follows the scroll.

use.en: Use it for steps, features or plans that should be shown one card at a time, in order.

meaning.en: The page background changes color by section
meaning.zh-Hans: 按区块切换页面背景色

ask.en: Add a background color change on scroll: blend smoothly from cream for the morning section to navy for night and light blue for the holiday section.
ask.zh-Hans: 给各区块加上滚动切换背景色：滚动时从早晨区块的奶油色平滑过渡到夜晚的藏蓝色，再到假日的浅蓝色。

summary.en: Each time the scroll moves into a new section, the whole page background blends from cream to navy to light blue; on the dark background the text turns white.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport with three sections, each 168 px (one screen). Scroll: 0→168 px over 0.3–1.2 s, 168→336 over 1.8–2.7 s, 336→0 over 3.3–4.4 s (cubic ease-in-out). One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).
Background colors: morning #FFEBD9 → night #1E2A4A → holiday #DDE6FF, painted as one color behind the whole page and blended while crossing a section boundary.
Blend: 0→1 between 5% and 95% of the scroll to the next section (quadratic ease-in-out), driven by scroll position, not by time.
Toward night the headline blends from navy to white and the body bars from beige to blue-gray; the section labels (01 MORNING …) stay orange.
Each section's picture (sun, moon and stars, mountain photo) moves with the page. The scrollbar thumb follows the scroll.

use.en: Use it on story-style pages where each chapter has its own mood, or to contrast scenes such as day and night or the seasons.

meaning.en: Hides on scroll down, returns on scroll up
meaning.zh-Hans: 向下滚动时隐藏，向上滚动时出现

ask.en: Make the header hide on scroll: slide it up out of view over 0.3 s when scrolling down, and bring it back as soon as the user scrolls up.
ask.zh-Hans: 把页头做成滚动隐藏页头：向下滚动时用 0.3 s 向上隐藏，只要稍微向上滚动就重新出现。

summary.en: Scrolling down slides the header up out of view to free the screen; scrolling up even a little brings it straight back.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport with a 34 px header fixed at the top. Scroll: 0→170 px over 0.3–1.1 s (down), 170→100 over 1.5–1.9 s (up), 100→230 over 2.4–2.9 s (down), 230→0 over 3.3–4.3 s (up), each with cubic ease-in-out. One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).
If the last movement was downward the header hides; if upward it shows. Within 34 px of the top of the page it always shows.
Hiding and showing both move it 36 px upward over 0.3 s (quadratic ease-in-out), like transform: translateY with a transition.
While scrolled, a 12 px shadow sits under the header (opacity 0→0.14 over the first 30 px of scroll). The scrollbar thumb follows the scroll.

use.en: Use it when screen space is tight, as on phones, to give the content more room while keeping the menu one small scroll away.

meaning.en: Highlights the current section in the menu
meaning.zh-Hans: 目录高亮当前阅读的章节

ask.en: Add scrollspy to the article's table of contents: highlight the item for the section being read in orange, switching over 0.25 s.
ask.zh-Hans: 给文章目录加上滚动监听：当前阅读章节的条目显示为朱红色，切换用时 0.25 s。

summary.en: As the article scrolls, the table-of-contents item for the section being read lights up, and the highlight moves on when the next heading comes in.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport: a table of contents on the left (150 px wide, 4 items) and the article on the right, with headings 100 px apart. Scroll: 0→100 over 0.3–0.9 s, →200 over 1.35–1.95 s, →300 over 2.4–3.0 s, 300→0 over 3.5–4.4 s (cubic ease-in-out). One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).
Current item = the last heading whose top is above scroll + 40 px (a trigger line 40 px below the top of the viewport).

When it changes, over 0.25 s (cubic ease-out) the item gets a pale orange background (126 × 26, radius 6) and an orange bar on its left (width 4), and its text turns from gray to bold orange; the previous item reverts over the same 0.25 s.
The table of contents stays put; only the article scrolls. The scrollbar thumb follows the scroll.

use.en: Use it on long articles, documentation or FAQs to show where the reader is within the whole page.

meaning.en: Appears lower down and returns you to the top
meaning.zh-Hans: 往下滚动后出现，点击回到顶部

ask.en: Add a back-to-top button to the article page: show it at the bottom right once the reader has scrolled a little, and scroll to the top in 0.6 s when clicked.
ask.zh-Hans: 给文章页加上回到顶部按钮：稍微滚动后显示在右下角，点击后用 0.6 s 滚回顶部。

summary.en: After scrolling down, a round arrow button appears at the bottom right; clicking it takes the page straight back to the top.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport. Scroll 0→300 px (to the bottom of the page) over 0.2–1.7 s, cubic ease-in-out. One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).
Button: an orange circle at the bottom right (center x = 472, y = 138; radius 19; white up arrow; 10 px shadow blur). Between 80 and 140 px of scroll it fades in while rising 10 px (cubic ease-out).
It is clicked at 2.6 s. While the cursor is on it, it darkens over 0.2 s (#FF5A2C → #D9431C).
After the click the scroll goes 300→0 over 2.66–3.26 s (0.6 s, cubic ease-in-out); below 80 px the button fades out by the same formula.

use.en: Use it on long pages such as blog posts, long landing pages or product lists, so readers can get back to the menu at the top.

meaning.en: An image grows to fill the screen as you scroll
meaning.zh-Hans: 图片随滚动放大至铺满屏幕

ask.en: Use zoom on scroll for the hero image: grow the small centered photo to fill the viewport as the user scrolls, then fade a headline in over it.
ask.zh-Hans: 首屏照片做成滚动放大：中央的小照片随滚动放大到铺满视口，完全展开后叠上标题。

summary.en: As the page scrolls, a small photo in the middle grows to fill the window, the text around it fades away and a headline appears over the photo.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport. Scroll progress p: 0→1 over 0.3–2.3 s, 1→0 over 3.0–4.4 s (cubic ease-in-out). One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).
Photo frame: from 155 × 90 in the middle (x = 178, y = 58, radius 8) to the full 511 × 168 window (radius 0); position, width, height and radius change in proportion to p.
The heading and text around it fade out while p goes 0→0.45 (opacity 1 − 2.2p).
While p goes 0.7→1, a white headline (26 px, 2 px letter spacing) fades in at the center of the photo. The scrollbar thumb follows the scroll.

use.en: Use it on travel, real-estate or brand sites to pull the visitor into the photo.

meaning.en: The card tilts in 3D following the cursor
meaning.zh-Hans: 卡片随光标方向立体倾斜

ask.en: Add a 3D tilt on hover to the member card: tilt it up to 18° following the cursor, with a moving glare.
ask.zh-Hans: 给会员卡加上 3D 倾斜：随光标位置最大倾斜 18°，反光也跟着移动。

summary.en: As the cursor moves over the card, the card tilts in depth to match the cursor position and a glare moves across its surface; it settles flat when the cursor leaves.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport with a 220 × 132 card (radius 14) in the middle. The cursor comes in, visits points near the card's corners every 0.6 s and leaves (cubic ease-in-out). One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).

Tilt: the cursor offset from the card center is divided by half the width and height to give −1…1; the horizontal offset × 0.32 rad (about 18°) is the rotation about Y, the vertical offset × 0.32 rad the rotation about X. The side under the cursor tips away.
Depth: viewer distance 520 px (like perspective: 520px); nearer parts are drawn larger.
On hover the tilt and glare ramp up over 0.4 s (cubic ease-out); on leave the card returns flat over the same 0.4 s.
Glare: a white radial light of radius 130 px at the cursor (opacity 0.42 at the center). The floor shadow shifts up to 10 px against the tilt.

use.en: Use it on member cards, product packaging or pricing cards to make them feel like objects you can pick up.

meaning.en: Only the area around the cursor lights up
meaning.zh-Hans: 只有光标周围变亮

ask.en: Add a spotlight hover to the feature cards: on the dark cards, light up only a circle of about 120 px around the cursor and make the borders glow too.
ask.zh-Hans: 给特色卡片加上聚光灯悬停：在深色卡片上只照亮光标周围半径约 120 px 的范围，边框也一起发光。

summary.en: As the cursor moves over the dark cards, only a circle around it is lit, and the edges of nearby cards glow.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport: a dark page (#121828) with three dark cards (147 × 116, radius 10). One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).
The cursor keeps moving in a figure eight: x = 255 + 190·sin(2πt/4.7), y = 92 + 40·sin(4πt/4.7).
Inside each card only, a white radial light of radius 115 px is centered on the cursor (opacity 0.34 at the center → 0); it does not spill outside the cards.
Card borders (width 2) glow by distance from the cursor: an orange radial light (rgb(255,122,82)) of radius 120 px. Far edges keep only the faint base line (8% white).
No lag: the light sits exactly at the cursor (the usual build puts the coordinates in CSS variables used as the radial-gradient center).

use.en: Use it on dark-themed sites with rows of feature or pricing cards, to make the spot under the pointer stand out.

meaning.en: Hovering swaps the photo for another shot
meaning.zh-Hans: 悬停时换成另一张照片

ask.en: Add an image swap on hover to the product grid: cross-fade to the back view over 0.3 s when the cursor is on a card.
ask.zh-Hans: 给商品列表加上悬停切换图片：光标停在卡片上时，用 0.3 s 叠化为背面照片。

summary.en: With the cursor on a product card, the front photo of the T-shirt cross-fades to a back view; it returns to the front when the cursor leaves.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport with two product cards (photo frame 196 × 112, radius 8, name and price below). The cursor rests on the left card, then the right one, for about 1.3 s each. One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).
On hover, over 0.3 s (quadratic ease-in-out), the front photo (small dot on the chest) cross-fades to the back photo (large star on the back); on leave it fades back over the same 0.3 s.
Two dots under the photo (radius 3) show which photo is showing (the dark dot is the current one).
The hover area is the whole card, including the name. The frame, name and price do not move.

use.en: Use it on e-commerce product grids to show another angle or an on-model shot without leaving the list.

meaning.en: Letters roll up and swap on hover
meaning.zh-Hans: 文字向上翻转并替换

ask.en: Give the main menu a text roll on hover: the letters roll up one by one, 0.035 s apart, revealing the same word in orange from below.
ask.zh-Hans: 给主导航加上悬停文字翻滚：光标悬停时文字逐字向上翻出，每字间隔 0.035 s，同样的朱红色文字从下方翻入。

summary.en: With the cursor on a menu word, its letters roll up and out one by one while the same word rolls in from below in orange; it rolls back when the cursor leaves.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport with three menu words (WORKS, ABOUT, CONTACT; 30 px, weight 800, 1 px letter spacing). The cursor rests on each, left to right, for about 0.85 s. One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).
An orange copy of each word sits 40 px below it, and both are clipped to a 39 px tall box (overflow: hidden).
On hover each letter, staggered by 0.035 s, moves 40 px up and out over 0.36 s (cubic ease-in-out) while its orange copy rises into place.
On leave the letters roll back down with the same stagger and timing.

use.en: Use it on header menus or buttons to give short text links a tactile response.

meaning.en: Hovering a list item shows its photo
meaning.zh-Hans: 悬停列表项时显示对应照片

ask.en: Turn the property list into a hover image reveal: when the cursor is on a row, show its photo beside the cursor over 0.25 s and let it follow the cursor.
ask.zh-Hans: 把设施列表做成悬停图片预览：光标停在某行时，用 0.25 s 在光标旁显示该行照片，并跟随光标移动。

summary.en: With the cursor on a row of a text-only list, that row's photo fades in beside the cursor and follows it.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport with a text-only list of four rows (39 px rows, 17 px names). The cursor moves down the rows, about 1 s on each. One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).
Hovered row: over 0.25 s (cubic ease-out) the name shifts 8 px right and the name and the arrow at the right turn orange; on leave they return over 0.25 s.
Photo: that row's photo (132 × 84, radius 6, drop shadow) appears 26 px right of the cursor, a little above it, kept inside the window vertically.
Over the same 0.25 s the photo goes from opacity 0 to 1 and from 0.85× to 1×. It follows the cursor without lag; moving to the next row fades the old photo out as the new one comes in.

use.en: Use it on lists of work, projects or properties that stay text-only and light, while letting people check a photo for the rows they care about.

meaning.en: The label floats up when you start typing
meaning.zh-Hans: 开始输入时标签上移

ask.en: Use floating labels in the form: on focus, shrink each label and move it onto the top border over 0.24 s.
ask.zh-Hans: 表单输入框使用浮动标签：获得焦点时，标签用 0.24 s 缩小并移到边框顶线上。

summary.en: Clicking the field shrinks the label and moves it onto the top border, leaving the field free for typing; empty and unfocused, the label moves back inside.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport with a 300 × 46 field (radius 8) holding the label "Email address" (email address, 15 px). The field is clicked at 0.65 s, and a click outside at 3.95 s removes focus. One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).

While focused or not empty, over 0.24 s (cubic ease-out) the label shrinks 15 → 11.5 px and moves from the middle of the field onto the top border (left padding 14 → 10 px); the border is masked in white behind it.
While focused, over 0.15 s (cubic ease-out) the border turns from gray to orange and 1.5 → 2.2 px wide, and the label turns orange.
"hello@example.com" is typed one character per 0.075 s from 1.0 s and deleted one per 0.03 s from 3.2 s. Once empty and unfocused, the label moves back inside over the same 0.24 s.
The text caret blinks every 0.9 s (it stays on while typing).

use.en: Use it on forms with many fields, to keep each label visible without taking extra space.

meaning.en: Shows right or wrong while you type
meaning.zh-Hans: 输入时即时显示对错

ask.en: Add inline validation to the contact form: while the email address is incomplete show a red "invalid format" message, and switch to a green check once it is valid.
ask.zh-Hans: 给联系表单加上实时校验：邮箱地址未输完整时显示红色“格式不正确”，正确后显示绿色对勾。

summary.en: While the email address is half typed the field turns red with an "invalid format" message; the moment it is complete it switches to a green check and "OK".

en: A 511 × 168 viewport with a 300 × 44 email field (radius 8). Clicked at 0.45 s, clicked away at 4.2 s. "hana@example.com" (16 characters) is typed one character per 0.115 s from 0.75 s and deleted one per 0.03 s from 3.6 s. One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).

From the second character until the last one is typed it is invalid: over 0.15 s (cubic ease-out) the border turns red (#E5383B), the fill pale red (#FFF1F1), and a red "!" circle with "Invalid format" (invalid format, 13 px) appears below.

When the last character makes it valid, over 0.25 s the border turns green (#1E9E5A), a green circle (radius 11, bouncing in with GSAP elastic.out(1, 0.3)) with a white check appears at the right end, and "OK" appears below.
While focused, the border turns from gray to navy and 1.5 → 2.2 px wide over 0.15 s. Once deletion starts, the messages go away.

use.en: Use it on sign-up or contact forms so people notice mistakes before they submit.

meaning.en: Shows loading, then done, inside the button
meaning.zh-Hans: 点击后在按钮内显示加载中到完成

ask.en: Make the submit button a loading button: on click, shrink it to a circle with a spinner over 0.3 s, then turn it green with a check and "Done".
ask.zh-Hans: 把提交按钮做成加载按钮：点击后用 0.3 s 收缩成圆形并显示加载圆环，完成后变成绿色对勾和“完成”。

summary.en: Clicking the submit button shrinks it to a circle with a spinner inside; when it finishes it widens into a green "Done" with a check.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport with an orange pill button, 220 × 36, labeled "Send" (Send). It is clicked at 0.8 s. One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).
Over 0.85–1.15 s (0.3 s, cubic ease-in-out) it shrinks from 220 to 36 px wide, a circle; the label fades in the first third of the shrink.
From 1.1 to 2.3 s a white spinner (radius 10, line width 3, 0.7π arc) turns once every 0.7 s inside the circle.

Over 2.25–2.45 s the color goes orange → green (#1E9E5A) and a white check draws over 2.25–2.5 s; over 2.45–2.8 s (cubic ease-in-out) it widens 36 → 150 px, the check moves 26 px left and "完了" (Done) appears.
It fades out over 3.9–4.1 s and the original "Send" button comes back, rising 6 px, over 4.1–4.4 s (cubic ease-out).

use.en: Use it on buttons that make people wait a moment for a result, such as submit, purchase or save.

meaning.en: A list photo expands into the detail page
meaning.zh-Hans: 列表中的照片直接展开为详情页

ask.en: Use a view transition from the works list to the detail page: the clicked photo should grow into the top of the detail page over 0.6 s.
ask.zh-Hans: 从作品列表进入详情页时使用视图过渡：被点击的照片用 0.6 s 直接放大到详情页顶部。

summary.en: Clicking a photo in the list grows that same photo into the image at the top of the detail page while the rest changes to the detail page; going back shrinks it into place.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport with three photos in a list (143 × 80, radius 6). The middle photo is clicked at 0.75 s, and "← Back to list" (back to list) on the detail page at 3.05 s. One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).

Forward: over 0.85–1.45 s (0.6 s, cubic ease-in-out) the clicked photo moves and resizes continuously from its list slot to the 479 × 94 image at the top of the detail page (radius 8). It stays one photo throughout.
The other photos and the heading fade out over the first 62% of the move; the detail title, text and back button fade in over the last 40%. At 50% the URL changes from /works to /works/02.
Back: over 3.15–3.75 s (0.6 s) the same move runs in reverse to the list slot.
This is how the View Transitions API looks when the list photo and the detail photo share the same view-transition-name.

use.en: Use it on galleries or product pages that go back and forth between a list and a detail view, so people never lose track of what they opened.

meaning.en: Opens an image large over a dimmed page
meaning.zh-Hans: 点击图片后在变暗的背景上放大

ask.en: Let visitors view the case-study photos in a lightbox: on click, dim the page and enlarge the photo in the center, with arrows to go to the previous or next photo.
ask.zh-Hans: 让施工案例照片可以在灯箱中查看：点击后背景变暗、照片在中央放大，用左右箭头切换上一张和下一张。

summary.en: Clicking a thumbnail in the gallery dims the page and shows that photo large in the center; the × shrinks it back into its thumbnail.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport with four thumbnails (108 × 72, radius 6). The third is clicked at 0.75 s, and the × at the top right at 3.0 s. One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).
Open: over 0.85–1.3 s (0.45 s, cubic ease-out) a dark overlay (rgb(14,18,28), opacity 0 → 0.82) covers the page and the clicked thumbnail grows to 261 × 128 in the center.
Over the second half of the open, "3 / 4" appears below the photo, previous/next arrows at the sides and a × at the top right.
Close: over 3.05–3.4 s (0.35 s, cubic ease-in-out) the same move runs in reverse and the photo returns to its thumbnail.

use.en: Use it for case studies, portfolios or product photos that should be seen large without leaving the page.

meaning.en: Dots on an image open notes when clicked
meaning.zh-Hans: 点击图片上的圆点显示说明

ask.en: Add hotspots to the product photo: put pulsing dots on the key features and open a tooltip over 0.25 s when one is clicked.
ask.zh-Hans: 给商品照片加上图片热点：在特色部位放置脉动的圆点，点击后用 0.25 s 弹出说明气泡。

summary.en: White dots pulse on the product picture; clicking one opens a tooltip about that part, and clicking another dot swaps the tooltip.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport: a product picture (a backpack) on the left, name and price on the right, with two dots on the picture (white circle, radius 8, drop shadow; orange center, radius 4). One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).
Pulse: from each dot a white ring (width 2) grows from radius 8 to 20 while fading from 0.75 to 0 opacity, every 1.57 s (a third of 4.7 s), two rings half a period apart.
At 0.9 s the upper dot is clicked: a tooltip (136 × 48, radius 8, with a pointer toward the dot) appears to its left over 0.25 s (cubic ease-out), rising 6 px.
At 2.4 s the lower dot is clicked: the first tooltip fades over 0.25 s and the next one opens to the right of the lower dot. A second click at 3.8 s closes it.

use.en: Use it on products, floor plans or maps, to explain different spots within one picture.

meaning.en: Counts down the time left to a deadline
meaning.zh-Hans: 显示距截止时间的剩余时间并递减

ask.en: Add a countdown timer for the campaign deadline: hours, minutes and seconds, with each changing digit rolling in from below over 0.3 s.
ask.zh-Hans: 给活动截止时间加上倒计时：以时:分:秒显示，每次数字变化时新数字用 0.3 s 从下方滚入。

summary.en: The hours, minutes and seconds under "Offer ends in" (until the campaign ends) count down every second; only the digits that change slide up and out as new ones come in from below.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport: an orange gradient band with "Offer ends in" (until the campaign ends) and six digit tiles for hours, minutes and seconds (34 × 50 each, radius 6, 32 px digits). This card alone runs once per 9.4 s (the pack cycle).
It starts at 02:15:04 and counts down one second at a time, nine times, every 1 s from 0.4 s, ending at 02:14:55. At 4.4 s, 02:15:00 → 02:14:59 rolls the minutes over.
Only the tiles whose digit changes animate: over 0.32 s (cubic ease-in-out) the old digit slides up and out and the new one slides in from below, clipped to the tile.
At 9.4 s it goes back to 02:15:04 with a plain cut.

use.en: Use it before a limited-time offer or an application deadline, to make the time left plain to see.

meaning.en: A wavy section divider that keeps moving
meaning.zh-Hans: 持续摆动的波浪形区块分隔线

ask.en: Add an animated shape divider between the hero and the next section: two white wave layers drifting slowly in opposite directions.
ask.zh-Hans: 在首屏与下一节之间加入动态形状分隔线：叠放两层白色波浪，缓慢地反向持续摆动。

summary.en: Where a blue section meets a white one, two layered wave shapes keep swaying slowly.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport: a blue gradient section on top (#3B64E8 → #8FA9F7) and a white section below, with two wave shapes layered at the boundary. One loop takes 4.7 s (two per 9.4 s pack cycle).
Back wave (white, opacity 0.45): centered at y = 100, the sum of a sine with wavelength 260 px, amplitude 8 px and one with wavelength 130 px, amplitude 4 px.
Front wave (white): centered at y = 110, wavelength 300 px / amplitude 9 px plus wavelength 110 px / amplitude 3.5 px; it runs into the white section below.

With phase a = 2π·t/4.7, the back wave uses a + 1 and −2a, the front wave −a and 2a + 0.5. The two sines in each wave run in opposite directions, so the shape keeps changing and returns to where it started every 4.7 s.

use.en: Use it where section edges should look soft rather than ruled, on sites about the sea, summer or children, for example.

meaning.en: The heart pops with a burst when liked
meaning.zh-Hans: 点击后爱心迸发弹出

ask.en: Add a like button animation to posts: fill the heart red, bounce it up to 1.45×, scatter a few small particles and count up by one.
ask.zh-Hans: 给帖子的点赞按钮加上点赞动画：点击后爱心填充红色并弹到 1.45×，周围散开小颗粒，数字加 1。

summary.en: Clicking the heart fills it red with a springy pop, small particles burst around it and the count beside it goes up by one; clicking again undoes it.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport: a post card with an outlined heart (line width 2.4) and the count "128" on the right. The heart is clicked at 0.9 s and clicked again at 3.3 s to undo. One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).
In the 0.1 s before the click it squeezes to 0.78×; at the click it fills red (#F23D5C), grows 0.78 → 1.45× in 0.12 s (cubic ease-out), then settles to 1× as 1 + 0.45·e^(−7t)·cos(15t).
0.08–0.58 s after the click: a red ring (radius 15 → 33, opacity 0.5 → 0) and six small particles in six directions (red, yellow, orange) flying out from radius 24 to 37 as they fade.
Count: 0.05–0.35 s after the click (cubic ease-out) 128 slides up and out and a red 129 comes in from below; undoing slides it back down to 128.
Undo: the heart goes back to an outline and dips to 0.84× and back over 0.4 s around the click (no particles).

use.en: Use it on like, favorite or save buttons, to confirm the tap clearly and pleasantly.

meaning.en: A looping cue that invites you to scroll down
meaning.zh-Hans: 持续循环、引导向下滚动的动画

ask.en: Add a scroll-down cue below the hero: a dot inside a mouse outline slides down and fades about every 1.5 s, on repeat.
ask.zh-Hans: 在首屏下方加入向下滚动提示：鼠标轮廓内的小圆点约每 1.5 s 向下移动并消失，循环播放。

summary.en: Below the hero, the word "SCROLL", a dot inside a mouse outline and arrows on either side keep repeating a downward motion.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport. Centered below the hero: "SCROLL" (11 px, 3 px letter spacing) and a mouse outline (24 × 38, radius 12, line width 2.2). One beat takes 1.57 s (three per 4.7 s, six per 9.4 s pack cycle).
The orange dot inside (5 × 9) drops 14 px over the first 70% of the beat (quadratic ease-in-out), fades out between 45% and 75%, and reappears at the top on the next beat.
40 px to each side, two down-chevrons (line width 2.5) per side, half a beat apart, drift 24 px downward; their opacity follows a sine, 0 → 0.8 → 0.

use.en: Use it when the hero fills the screen and people need a hint that the page goes on below.

meaning.en: A video plays behind the hero section
meaning.zh-Hans: 首屏背景中播放视频

ask.en: Give the hero a background video: muted and looping, with a dark gradient on the left so the headline stays readable.
ask.zh-Hans: 首屏使用背景视频：静音循环播放，左侧叠加深色渐变，保证标题清晰可读。

summary.en: In the hero background, clouds and waves keep moving, while the headline and button sit still on top.

en: A 511 × 168 viewport. Background footage (sky, clouds, mountains, sea) fills the hero, with a still headline (28 px, white) and button on top. The footage loops every 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).
Clouds: the far layer repeats every 170 px and moves 170 px right per 4.7 s (about 36 px/s); the near layer repeats every 340 px and moves 340 px per 4.7 s (about 72 px/s). The mountains stay still.

Sea: three waves (y = 118, 130, 146; amplitude 2.5–3 px; wavelength 90, 60, 120 px); only the middle one runs the other way and moves two wavelengths per 4.7 s (the other two move one wavelength to the right).
For legibility, a 12% navy layer covers the footage, a gradient darkens the left 300 px (opacity 0.45 → 0), and the headline has a shadow (10 px blur).
A playing badge (pause, muted) sits at the bottom right. On a real site the video uses autoplay, muted, loop and playsinline.

use.en: Use it on hero sections for travel, hotels, restaurants or recruiting, where atmosphere and motion say more than one photo.
